messages:
liz: FYI NewGuard (enterprise) asked for a POC. Their checklist: SSO (SAML SP + IdP flows), SCIM 2.0 (delta + bulk import), strict domain locking to their corporate domains (newguard.com + app.newguard.com), SCIM groups -> role mapping, audit streaming to Splunk, EU data residency, and dedicated pilot pricing. Can we run this as a 2-week Dedicated pilot?

oliver-se: yes we can. SAML support: both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated. We prefer persistent NameID or email as NameID. We support SAML group attribute and attribute-to-role mapping. No technical blocker.

oliver-se: quick SAML template we ask for:```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sp.redwood.ai/newguard">
  <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://sp.redwood.ai/saml/acs" />
  <Attribute Name="urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3"> email </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="groups"> groups </Attribute>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

kelly-ps: POC runbook (short): 1) provision trial tenant + 2-node Dedicated pool (2x GPUs) 2) exchange SP metadata 3) configure SCIM token + run initial bulk import 4) map 3 example groups to roles 5) enable audit forwarding to customer's HTTP(S) endpoint 6) smoke test SSO + group sync. Expect 7 business days if IdP admin and DNS ppl are available.

marco: SCIM details: we implement SCIM 2.0 (PATCH + bulk POST supported). Delta sync via incremental change tokens (recommended). For initial on-boarding we support a one-time bulk import CSV/JSON if they prefer. Rate limits: hosted default 600 reqs/min; Dedicated pilot can have limits raised to 3k reqs/min for onboarding windows. Clarify churn pattern.

liz: they have ~15k employees, want groups synced daily but some teams with high churn (contractors) might update groups frequently. They asked if we can do near-realtime group reflect for specific teams.

oliver-se: we can shorten delta window for high-churn groups; for extremely high churn we recommend event-driven provisioning from their IdP -> we accept SCIM push via our ingest API as well. We'll document recommended thresholds.

samir: pricing: we can offer a 2-week Dedicated pilot at 60% off list for proof-of-concept (paid). If they sign an annual committed Dedicated plan we can credit pilot fees. For commercial sizing I need expected throughput: concurrency + avg tokens. Can sales confirm target concurrency and token lengths?

liz: they estimated 300 concurrent sessions with medium chat context (~512 tokens) during business hours. Is pilot 2 GPUs sufficient?

oliver-se: for 300 concurrent and 512 token contexts we'd recommend 3-4 GPU cards for stable p99 latency < 800ms on our recommended model. Kelly, we'll include two sizing options (cost-optimized vs latency SLO).

kelly-ps: security questions checklist: SOC2 Type II yes, we can provide report. Pen test summary available (full report under NDA). Data at rest default KMS; for Private we can support customer-managed KMS. Audit streaming: syslog or HTTPS with token auth; we can ensure <60s push latency for Dedicated pilot. Retention: default 12 months, can extend to 24/36 on enterprise add-on (we'll confirm 13-month ask). Data residency: EU region Dedicated or Private deploy.

tina: please attach SOC2 and pen-test summary to the thread; I'll prepare a tailored security questionnaire response. Also confirm if we redact user PII in logs or include full identity fields for audit events.

audit-bot: uploaded SOC2_report_redacted.pdf and pentest-summary-redwood.pdf (link: https://redwood.internal/qna/1719999999).

marco: domain proofing flow: we support two options: (1) DNS TXT under _redwood-verification.newguard.com with token, or (2) CNAME verification for customers who prefer not to add TXT entries. For locking to subdomains we require proof on both apex and the specific subdomain. Certificate issuance begins after verification.

liz: NewGuard also asked about SCIM mapping examples and whether we support nested groups.

marco: SCIM mapping example (snippet):```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "{{user.email}}",
  "name": {"givenName": "{{user.firstName}}", "familyName": "{{user.lastName}}"},
  "groups": ["engineering:backend","support:level1"]
}
```
We support group namespacing via delimiter. Nested groups: SCIM spec doesn't standardize nested groups; we can accept a flattened representation or map via custom attribute. We'll include guidance.

samir: next step commercial ask: are trial Dedicated pilots refundable? Standard policy is pilot invoice due upfront, refundable if we fail to meet agreed acceptance criteria. We'll draft a pilot term sheet.

kelly-ps: I'll prepare the POC runbook + SCIM bulk import template + DNS verification instructions. Also will include escalation contacts for IdP and infra.

liz: agreed next steps: (1) oliver to post sizing doc + SAML metadata sample (EOD) (2) kelly to attach runbook + SCIM bulk template + DNS/CNAME proof steps (tomorrow AM) (3) tina to attach SOC2 answers + PII/logging detail (tomorrow) (4) samir to send pilot commercial term sheet and billing flow (today) (5) schedule 30m call with NewGuard IdP admin for Tuesday.

oliver-se: noted, I'll add two sizing profiles in the doc (cost vs latency).

samir: sending pilot term sheet now, cc procurement.

liz: thanks team. tagging @NewGuard-rep when we have materials. :thumbsup:
